args.description: sheathes the nodachi the real iaido way, in keyframes: she snaps the blade down to her right side once, the point low; then brings the blade level across in front of her belly, the back of the blade laid on her left hand at the mouth of the scabbard at her left hip; she slides the blade back along her left hand until its point slips into the scabbard mouth; then smoothly pushes the level blade back into the scabbard, her right hand coming back to her hip, the blade getting shorter, until the gold guard touches the mouth; then holds the stance still, her right hand on the handle. The character stays at the same place in the frame (the game moves her), always facing right, seen from the side; keep her look, proportions and colours exactly. Only the character is drawn, with what she holds, the whole body inside the picture, on an empty background. Every frame shows the arms, legs and weapon in a crisp pose.
args.subject_description: adult woman, very long silver-white ponytail with red ribbons and beads, red eyes, black sleeveless top, long white coat with red-gold flames off the shoulders, red belt, black fingerless gloves, baggy black trousers, red and black boots, red scabbard at the hip, holding a curved nodachi
args.initial_pose: calm iai fighting stance facing right, holding the drawn nodachi low in her right hand, the point forward, her left hand on the scabbard at her hip
